summary: Afya Limited, a Brazilian medical-education group listed on Nasdaq and B3, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 earnings release. Revenue rose 6.1% year over year to R$985.2 million, Adjusted EBITDA grew 8.7% to R$433.8 million (44.0% margin), and net income increased 7.2% to R$171.0 million; nine-month revenue reached R$2,970.0 million with 99.5% cash conversion. Full-year 2026 guidance was reaffirmed. No transaction, board recommendation, or special-situations mechanics are present; the filing is a routine periodic results announcement.
